author: ETA PRIME
description:
FSR 4.1 is finally here for handhelds, but is it worth the performance hit? I tested the new preview driver on the ROG Xbox Ally X20 and compared it against FSR 2.1 and FSR 3.1. Works on Ryzen Z2 Extreme handhelds like the ROG Xbox Ally X and Ally X20. This is the lighter handheld model of FSR 4.1, less than half the size of the full version, built for RDNA 3.5 GPUs.
